description: Create an md2sign account for your human and get an API key. They are emailed a confirmation link and subscription options. Once they confirm their email they pick a plan at checkout; if account.trial.available is true it starts with a 7-day free trial (card taken, not charged until it ends; 3 envelopes, up to 5 signers each), otherwise it is charged at checkout. Plans: Solo Lite $45/year for 60 envelopes a year, Solo $7.50/mo for 30 a month, Team $19/mo for 100 with team features, Business+ $39/mo for 500; one envelope is one document sent, however many sign. You can validate, draft, preview and test-send right away. Returns api_key, checkout_urls (monthly) and annual_checkout_urls (yearly; Solo Lite is only here) to hand to the human.

company_name.description: Business name shown to recipients, e.g. "Acme Pty Ltd". Ask whether they have one; leave it out to use their own name.

email.description: Email address of your human. Document emails show it as the sender.

name.description: The full name of your human, as they want recipients to see it. Ask them; don't guess it from the email address.

name: create_account
title: Create an md2sign account
